title: Ambient LLMs: Data-Efficient Supervised Fine-tuning via Temperature Matching
why_read: A concrete, well-motivated technique for improving supervised fine-tuning data efficiency, with reported double-digit gains over standard SFT.
analysis: The paper tackles a real problem: fine-tuning datasets are much smaller than pretraining data, causing models to forget rare patterns they learned during pretraining. Their fix has the fine-tuned model match a 'blurred' (high-temperature) version of the original pretrained model's predictions, using a temperature knob that interpolates between plain fine-tuning and full knowledge distillation. This is a practical, implementable idea for anyone training or fine-tuning language models, not just a theoretical exercise. The claimed 21% average relative improvement across several task types makes it worth scrutiny by practitioners.
